overview: This item migrates the HTN planner's error handling to use Zoi as the primary mechanism for representing, propagating, and classifying errors. The goal is to replace ad hoc tuples, exceptions, and custom error structs with Zoi-compatible error values that encode context (e.g., plan, task, method, world state, effect) in a consistent way. This will align HTN with the broader Jido ecosystem and enable better error introspection, logging, and control-flow decisions. The work includes identifying all error-producing paths in planning and execution (failed preconditions, method selection failures, dead-ends, action errors), defining Zoi error types that capture these cases, and updating function signatures and call sites accordingly. The output is a refactored HTN core that uses Zoi end-to-end, with updated tests verifying unchanged or improved behavior.
title: Convert to Zoi error handling
